description.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
description.nl: In de afgelopen 2 weken, hoe vaak had u last van de volgende problemen?

text.en: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
text.nl: Neiging om me nerveus, angstig of onrustig te voelen

text.en: Not being able to stop or control worrying
text.nl: Moeite met stoppen of beheersen van zorgen

text.en: Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen
text.nl: Angst dat er iets verschrikkelijks kan gebeuren
